en: A vintage black‑and‑white street view showing a row of multi‑story townhouses and shops. On the left is a distinctive corner building with curved balconies, flower boxes, and a tower‑like upper section. On the right side of the street are several shopfronts with awnings and signage, tram tracks in the road, and a few pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. At the top, printed in orange, is the caption "Freiberg i. Sa." indicating the location.
